info.name: Booking App API
info.description: Bo test day du cho booking_app_be: chay tuan tu tu tren xuong (Collection Runner) de xay dung du lieu qua tung buoc - admin -> owner -> chain -> manager -> branch -> staff -> room/amenity/service/dish/tour -> customer -> booking -> chat -> AI -> report, kem cac test kiem tra phan quyen (AccessGuard). Moi bien duoc luu tu dong vao Collection Variables qua script Tests cua tung request, khong can chinh tay. Chat realtime dung WebSocket ws://localhost:8080/booking-app/api/v1/ws/chat?token=<accessToken> (Postman: New > WebSocket); Collection Runner chi chay phan REST.

item.name: Daily occupancy rejects a range over 92 days
GET chain revenue by room type
GET revenue summary (manager, KPIs vs previous period)

exec: pm.test('current period is the requested range', () => { pm.expect(d.current.from).to.eql('2026-01-01'); pm.expect(d.current.to).to.eql('2026-12-31'); });
pm.test('previous period: same length, ends the day before', () => { pm.expect(d.previous.from).to.eql('2025-01-01'); pm.expect(d.previous.to).to.eql('2025-12-31'); });
pm.test('the November payslip (5.200.000, paid) is the payroll cost', () => pm.expect(d.current.payrollCost).to.eql(5200000));
pm.test('new then returning guests; nobody stayed before 2026, so nobody returns', () => { pm.expect(d.byCustomerType[0].key).to.eql('NEW'); pm.expect(d.byCustomerType[1].count).to.eql(0); });

item.name: GET revenue summary on the tour day counts the completed tour

exec: pm.test('tour 450.000 x 2 guests is tour revenue (the package room earns via its own booking)', () => pm.expect(d.current.tourRevenue).to.eql(900000));
pm.test('the chain total includes the completed tour', () => pm.expect(d.current.tourRevenue).to.eql(900000));
pm.test('twelve months, empty ones included', () => { pm.expect(months.length).to.eql(12); pm.expect(months[0].start).to.eql('2026-01-01'); pm.expect(months[11].end).to.eql('2026-12-31'); });
pm.test('2026 has 53 ISO weeks, the first cut to 1 January', () => { pm.expect(weeks.length).to.eql(53); pm.expect(weeks[0].start).to.eql('2026-01-01'); pm.expect(weeks[0].week).to.eql(1); });
